sentences.en: He spent all night cramming for the test.
sentences.zh: 他整晚都在为考试临时抱佛脚。

sentences.en: Learning a language goes far beyond cramming a dictionary into your memory.
sentences.zh: 学习一门语言远不止是把字典的内容塞进脑子里。

sentences.en: Simply cramming the material makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 仅仅死记硬背这些材料毫无意义。

senses.zh: 填鸭式的学习（教法）;塞满v.塞满;填鸭式学习;“cram”的现在分词
